**C10 LED Control V18** — free app for the C10 LED front bar (Leapmotor C10).

- 📱 `C10-LED-Control-V18-release.apk` — Android app (installs over previous versions).
- 💻 `LEDBAR_C10_JUANLU_Install.exe` — Windows firmware installer. Ask for the installer key in a private message on Telegram: [@juanludetoledo](https://t.me/juanludetoledo).
- 📖 Manuals: [Español](https://github.com/juanludetoledo/C10-LED-Bar/blob/main/MANUAL.md) · [English](https://github.com/juanludetoledo/C10-LED-Bar/blob/main/MANUAL.en.md) · [Português](https://github.com/juanludetoledo/C10-LED-Bar/blob/main/MANUAL.pt.md) · [中文](https://github.com/juanludetoledo/C10-LED-Bar/blob/main/MANUAL.zh.md)
